messages:
Maya: Anyone got an extra ethernet switch/splitter we can borrow for a 4-player LAN tomorrow? Need ~5 usable ports, preferably unmanaged so we don't fight VLANs.
Jon: I have a little Netgear 8-port that should do it. Can drop by at 6pm. :thumbsup: 
Claire: Which room are you using? Conf A is free after 6, but the table is lower. Conf C has power strips.
Maya: Planning to use the back lounge (near kitchen) so we can snack. Conf A is ok if people prefer tables.
Ben: I can bring an unmanaged 5-port switch and a spare Cat6 cable. Would that help?
Maya: Perfect -- 5-port is ideal. Thanks Ben & Jon!
Priya: I'll bring a small surge protector and extra power bricks. Also who wants to do Steam library sharing for Rocket League? :joystick:
Jon: Count me in for Rocket League + Smash spectating.
Ben: Is Smash even happening? My Switch dock is at home but I can stream locally if people want.
Claire: If anyone needs temporary IPs set, ping me. Quick tip: if you're on laptop and want a static for port-forward testing, you can use:```
# on mac/linux
sudo ifconfig en0 192.168.5.50 netmask 255.255.255.0
# on windows (admin cmd)
netsh interface ip set address "Ethernet" static 192.168.5.50 255.255.255.0 192.168.5.1
```
Maya: Oof thanks Claire. Also does anyone have a short ethernet cable (1m)? My rig is tight to the couch.
Jon: I have a 1m patch cable. Bringing it.
Priya: Snacks poll: who can bring something? (reply with emoji)
- Maya: I'll bring soda.
- Jon: Chips :potato: 
- Ben: I can bring cookies :cookie: 
- Claire: I'll grab a veggie tray :leafy_green: 
network-bot: Room reservation notice: "Back Lounge" reserved by Maya from 18:00-22:00 tomorrow.
Maya: Awesome, thanks bot. Anyone want to share a controller for Smash? I have one extra pro pad.
Ben: I can lend my Pro Controller. Also reminder: bring headphones if you need low volume.
Priya: Does anyone want to try the new indie co-op on Steam? Might be a fun warm-up.
Jon: Good call. Let's do a warm-up lobby at 7:15, then Rocket League at 7:45, Smash after.
Maya: Sounds good. Thanks everyone for the gear help. See you tomorrow! :party_popper:
